title: Spectra — Paint-to-Sound Studio
description: Paint on a time-frequency canvas and hear it resynthesised by a 60-row additive oscillator bank — then export the WAV.
concept: Spectra inverts the spectrogram: instead of analysing sound into a picture, you paint the picture and the app synthesises the sound. The canvas is 96 time frames wide and 60 scale-snapped pitch rows tall, so every mark you make is already in key. Five brushes let you dab soft glows, draw one-row ribbons, stamp chords, stack harmonic combs, or smear noise bands; four voices (pure sine, harmonic stack, detuned chorus, inharmonic bell) decide the timbre of every row. A full stereo render — Schroeder shimmer, soft-clip drive, normalisation — runs in about half a second, so playback is always live, and the result exports as a real 16-bit WAV, a PNG of the painting, or a URL that carries the entire canvas.
features: Five brushes — Glow, Ribbon, Chord, Harmonics and Noise Band — plus a soft eraser with size and strength controls
Four synthesis voices (pure sine, harmonic stack, detuned chorus, inharmonic bell) rendered by an additive oscillator bank
Scale snapping across five scales and eight roots, spanning exactly five octaves regardless of scale
Six generative sketches (Bell Rain, Cathedral, Chirp Ladder, Aurora, Pulse Grid, Surprise Me) to paint over
Live stereo render with Schroeder shimmer reverb, soft-clip drive and looped playback with a moving playhead
16-bit stereo WAV export, PNG export of the painting, localStorage autosave plus a save slot, and a shareable URL that encodes the whole canvas
tech: Hand-written additive resynthesis with a 8192-entry sine table
State-variable resonant bandpass for noise voices

interaction.mouse: Drag across the canvas to paint — time runs left to right, pitch bottom to top; strokes interpolate so fast drags stay continuous.
interaction.click: Pick a brush, voice, scale or sketch from the right-hand panel; Play auditions the render, WAV/PNG/Link export it.
interaction.touch: Single-finger drag paints exactly like the mouse; the panel stacks below the canvas and scrolls on small screens.
interaction.keyboard: Space toggles playback, Ctrl/Cmd+Z undoes a stroke, B selects the Glow brush and E the eraser.
